description: Defines the HttpChunkedDecoder class for decoding HTTP chunked transfer encoding, including methods for filtering buffers and parsing chunk sizes.

classes.name: HttpChunkedDecoder
classes.description: A class that handles decoding of HTTP chunked transfer encoding, managing chunk sizes, buffer filtering, and end-of-file detection.

methods.name: HttpChunkedDecoder
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the decoder state.

methods.name: reached_eof
methods.description: Returns whether the end of the chunked data has been reached.

methods.name: bytes_after_eof
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes after the final CRLF.

methods.name: FilterBuf
methods.description: Filters out chunk markers from the buffer and detects end of data.
